description.zh: 团队编制工具 · 让 Forge 在 Teammates 名单里没有合适角色时,自己铸造一个新队友(持久、跨会话、跨重启、不污染仓库)。暴露 team:create_role / team:list_roles。
description.en: Team Forge — lets Forge mint a brand-new teammate when no suitable role exists in the roster (persistent, cross-session, cross-restart, no repo pollution). Exposes team:create_role / team:list_roles.

confirmMessage.zh: Forge 想创建一个新队友,允许吗?
confirmMessage.en: Forge wants to create a new teammate — allow?

description.zh: 当 Teammates 名单(# Teammates 段)里没有合适的角色时,铸造一个新队友:传 id / persona(角色是谁、干什么、何时被派) + 可选 displayName / role / avatar / color / tools。成功后该角色立即持久化并进 roster,随后用 delegate_to_subagent(agent="<id>") 即可派它。撞名会报错,不覆盖。
description.en: When no suitable role exists in the roster, mint a new teammate: pass id / persona (who they are, what they do, when to delegate) plus optional displayName / role / avatar / color / tools. On success the role is persisted and joins the roster; then delegate_to_subagent(agent="<id>") dispatches it. Duplicate ids are rejected, never overwritten.

description.zh: 列出当前所有可派单角色(plugin agent + marketplace 内建),用于创建前查重、确认某角色是否已存在。
description.en: List all currently dispatchable roles (plugin agents + marketplace built-ins) — useful to check for duplicates before creating.
